channel.title: Akash Saini - AI, ML & Applied Math Engineering Notes
channel.description: Production AI systems, LLM evaluation, RAG architectures, and applied mathematics by Akash Saini (BITS Pilani).

item.title: Mitigating LLM Hallucinations: Instruction Fine-Tuning, RAG & Citation Grounding
item.description: Drawing from curating Gemini instruction fine-tuning workflows at Innodata and building FAISS RAG pipelines, here is a two-pronged defense against model fabrication.

item.title: From Symbolic Rules to Agentic Workflows: Designing Reliable AI Systems
item.description: Modern AI has evolved from static prediction endpoints into multi-step reasoning agents. Enterprise deployments succeed when probabilistic models are wrapped in deterministic verification gates.

item.title: The Mathematics of Generalization: Regularization, Bias-Variance & Hyperparameter Tuning
item.description: How L1/L2 regularization, stratified k-fold cross-validation, and margin maximization pushed our Fake News NLP pipeline to 95.0% out-of-sample accuracy.

item.title: Why 80% of Data Science Impact Happens Before Model.fit()
item.description: Lessons from scaling unstructured speech and text pipelines by 6,000x at Swecha: schema enforcement, deduplication, and metric alignment beat complex architectures.

item.title: Why SARIMA Outperformed ARIMA by 60% RMSE on 15-Year Energy Demand
item.description: Using Augmented Dickey-Fuller stationarity testing and seasonal differencing (D=1, s=12) to cut forecasting RMSE from 412.8 MWh down to 164.7 MWh.
